newsitem.title: USA: Iraq's Aziz meeting with incoming UN weapons chief.
newsitem.headline: Iraq's Aziz meeting with incoming UN weapons chief.

text.p: Iraqi Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz is meeting with the United Nations' incoming chief of weapons inspection Wednesday at 1600 EDT/2000 GMT at the official Iraqi residence in New York.

Richard Butler, who will assume the leadership of the UN's Special Commission on Iraq (UNSCOM) on July 1 when the UNSCOM Rolf Ekeus steps down, told Reuters the meeting would give he and Aziz a chance to get acquainted.
"It's really just to get to know each other," Butler said.
Aziz is in New York to attend the Earth Summit at the UN.
UN arms inspectors have had increasingly tense relations regarding inspections of Iraq's capability of making weapons of mass destruction.

A prime condition for any easing or lifting of sanctions in place since Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait is a clean bill of health from UNSCOM, which is in charge of scrapping baghdad's weapons of mass destruction.
This past weekend, the UN Security Council gave Iraq a stern warning telling Baghdad to comply with all requests for weapons inspections.
Baghdad had claimed that UN inspectors were violating Iraqi sovereignty by seeking to examine sensitive intelligence sites, and claimed inspectors entered religious holy sites.
-- Patrick Connole New York Oil Desk 1 212 859 1620
